rationale.risk-routing: Risk-ranked thresholds select which diffs are blocked for added scrutiny.
rationale.ai-review: LLMs independently score submitted diffs for severe-fault risk.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Blocked diffs require developer action; managers decide documented escalations.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Phabricator displays risk scores, reasons, feedback, and possible actions.
rationale.org-governance: Organization-wide freeze tiers, thresholds, accountability, and manager escalation govern releases.
rationale.metrics: Defines and applies diff-level quality risk scores predicting severe faults.
